task: MR07 补测：二分定位的临时测试世界/实例副本安全引导（A6）
closes: gap-register A6 (the temporary-test-world / instance-copy guidance required by the plan was never implemented)
implementation: A permanent safety block was added at the TOP of the bisect modal (title, sub-line, then #bisectSafety), and it is filled unconditionally - not inside any branch - so the guidance is also visible in the pending and needs-recovery states where it matters most. i18n adds bisec.safetyTitle and bisec.safety in both zh and en.
wording: The copy deliberately states three things the plan asked for: use a temporary test world or an instance copy; back up the original save yourself; and the launcher does NOT back up or copy saves automatically (so users do not assume they are covered).

tests.one: the modal contains the bisectSafety container and openModBisect (its function body) fills it using both keys
tests.two: both keys appear exactly twice in i18n.js (zh + en) and are non-empty
tests.three: the zh copy contains 临时测试世界 / 实例副本 / 备份 and explicitly says it does not auto-back-up
tests.four: the en copy covers temporary test world / instance copy / back up / does NOT back up
tests.nature: These are source-level assertions because the Node environment has a minimal fake DOM with no real rendering; the same approach as the A13 static inventory.

redBaselines.invalid: changing the fill to if (false && safety) produced 0 failures - the assertions are source-level, so a runtime-only change does not falsify them. Recorded honestly.
redBaselines.valid: deleting the bisec.safetyTitle usage from the source produced 1 failure (A6-1)
redBaselines.lesson: A RED must break at the same level as the assertion: source-level assertions need a source-level break.

verification.syntax: node --check passes for launcher.js and i18n.js

stillNotCovered: real GUI rendering not verified (no desktop session)
no actual save backup/copy action was implemented - the plan only asked for guidance, and the launcher still does not touch save paths
the do-not-enter-the-real-world / no-world-save-disabling promises remain unimplemented (no world logic was touched)
a real Minecraft test copy was not started
